comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body:
Narrowed by the sprint-board brace work (a_25S3ICERd). The guarantee still holds for everything issue #139 hit - `"{tokens.join(" ")}"` and the ternary form both still work - but a nested same-delimiter string is no longer allowed *immediately* after the `{`.

Reason: `"{"` is now also how a literal opening brace at the end of a string is written, and the two readings share that exact prefix. Alex's call was that `"{"ERROR".red()}"` should be unidiomatic anyway - switch quote types.

`docs-web/docs/guide/strings-advanced.md` updated with the exception, since it stated the guarantee unconditionally.

creator: Alexander Terp
description: Nested double quotes inside interpolation ("{tokens.join(sep=" ")}") works, but is undocumented - the #139 author nearly rewrote working code fearing it was accidental. Document it as guaranteed behavior in the strings docs (and ideally pin with a test if one does not exist).
title: Docs: guarantee nested quotes inside interpolation
